phases.name: 1 · Foundations
phases.description: New app on the scop engine, honest fps, thinking in parallel, compute pipelines, the particle buffer

phases.name: 2 · Particles on screen
phases.description: Create particles on the GPU, draw points, compute → graphics handover (interop), frames in flight

phases.name: 3 · Simulation
phases.description: Gravity and motion, cursor to world, colour by distance

phases.name: 4 · Performance
phases.description: Measure, fast simulation, cheap drawing, engine overhead audit, weaker machines. Targets: 1M at 60 fps, 3M at 20 fps

phases.name: 5 · Mandatory finish
phases.description: make one-liner, README, defence checklist. Bonus is only graded if this is perfect.

phases.name: 6 · Bonus
phases.description: Free-fly camera, GPU atomics, emitters with life span, engine consolidation, creativity extras

workflow: Read the section and answered its gate questions
Gate passed (misses re-taught, fresh question re-asked)
Checkpoint code written by Claude, walked through part by part
Explain-back passed: can explain every line
AI-written code noted in README → AI usage
verify: cargo run --release -p particle_system -- 1000000 (checked on the Mac; fps from release only)

tasks.title: engine/build.rs: compile `.comp` shaders too (before § 3)
tasks.body: `engine/build.rs` only picks up `vert` and `frag` files. Compute shaders (`.comp`) must be compiled to SPIR-V and get a committed `spv/` fallback like the others. The Makefile's `spv` target already includes `*.comp`.

tasks.title: Confirm Vulkan compute runs on a 42 Madrid campus machine
tasks.body: The defence runs on campus hardware. As soon as § 3's test dispatch works, run it there: check the queue family supports COMPUTE and note the GPU's limits (§ 2 printout).

tasks.title: Benchmark 1M @ 60 fps and 3M @ 20 fps on a campus machine
tasks.body: Release build, uncapped present mode. Record frame times in ms for 1M and 3M particles on the Mac and on campus in `DECISIONS.md` or the README. The mandatory part fails if either target is missed on the evaluation machine.

tasks.title: Move engine test fixtures inside `engine/`
tasks.body: Engine unit tests read `../resources/*.obj` (copied from scop on 2026-11-24 so `cargo test` passes). That couples the engine to the app's folder layout. Move them to `engine/tests/fixtures/` (or similar) during § 21.

tasks.title: Defence: show that particles never exist in RAM
tasks.body: Walk the code: no CPU-side particle array, no staging buffer for particles, buffer created DEVICE_LOCAL and filled by the init compute shader only. Prepare a 30-second explanation.

tasks.title: Defence: explain Vulkan interop (barriers / release-acquire)
tasks.body: The subject's 'memory acquire and release' wording is written for OpenCL/OpenGL. Prepare the Vulkan equivalent from § 7 and `DECISIONS.md`, with the barrier code ready to show.

tasks.title: Final README: Description, Instructions, Resources, AI usage
tasks.body: AI usage must state that Claude writes the checkpoint code after each gate and that the engine was carried over from scop, built the same way.

tasks.title: Defence prep: collect traps and decisions
tasks.body: Fill `00-PLAN.md → Defence prep` from `DECISIONS.md` and each section's Known traps as sections close.

tasks.title: Choose creativity extras for the bonus
tasks.body: After § 17: pick extras (e.g. several gravity points, shapes, trails, presets). Each gets its own learning section.

tasks.title: Catch up `learn_es/` (Spanish mirror)
tasks.body: Paused by choice. Translate finished sections, ANSWERS and GLOSSARY in batches; then `python3 scripts/check_learn.py` should be clean.
